title: BASALT SQLite WAL/FULL trusted-state backend conformance
claim_ceiling: Evaluates normalized local SQLite state persistence, transactional all-or-nothing behavior under injected write aborts, exact-receipt recovery, independent-connection CAS, schema constraints and state-digest consistency. It does not qualify physical power-loss durability, filesystem/VFS/hardware behavior, external freshness, malicious snapshot rollback, signatures, witnesses or a remote authoritative anchor.

scenarios.mutation: Commit generation one, close database, reopen and inspect exact source/log/receipt state
scenarios.expected: revision and all three records persist; local anti-rollback remains false

scenarios.mutation: Inject abort immediately after source cursor write and before log write
scenarios.expected: transaction rolls back; complete pre-state remains after reopen

scenarios.mutation: Inject abort after log checkpoint write and before receipt write
scenarios.expected: transaction rolls back; complete pre-state remains after reopen

scenarios.mutation: Inject abort after accepted receipt insert and before metadata revision update
scenarios.expected: transaction rolls back; complete pre-state remains after reopen

scenarios.mutation: Inject abort after metadata write but before SQLite COMMIT
scenarios.expected: transaction rolls back; complete pre-state remains after reopen

scenarios.mutation: Two independent SQLite connections prepare the same receipt against one revision; first commits before second
scenarios.expected: second receives compare conflict; exact retry after reread returns already-committed

scenarios.mutation: Eight independent connections race the same prepared transition
scenarios.expected: exactly one durable commit; seven compare conflicts; no partial state

scenarios.mutation: Submit a plan prepared against database A to a divergent database B with the same revision
scenarios.expected: reject exact-state snapshot mismatch and leave B unchanged

scenarios.mutation: Mutate stored state digest without matching table state
scenarios.expected: reopen fails closed on state-digest mismatch

scenarios.mutation: Attempt to insert a second receipt for the same host/source/partition/generation
scenarios.expected: SQLite uniqueness constraint rejects the second generation receipt

scenarios.mutation: Open backend where WAL or synchronous FULL cannot be established
scenarios.expected: fail closed; do not advertise local atomicity backend configured

scenarios.mutation: Restore an older complete local database snapshot, including its old unkeyed digest
scenarios.expected: local checks may pass; anti-rollback must remain unknown/false without external anchor

scenarios.mutation: Open an existing symlink, non-regular database path, or an over-limit persisted state
scenarios.expected: Reject unsafe path or fail closed before admitting any new state transition

scenarios.mutation: Migrate an existing source to a new pinned transparency log with explicit continuity evidence, close and reopen the SQLite database
scenarios.expected: Persist the unchanged source key, next generation, predecessor seal and new log ID; retain old log history and reject migration without evidence

scenarios.mutation: Roll back a source cursor to an older accepted receipt but recompute the unkeyed local state digest
scenarios.expected: Reject because the latest source cursor does not point to the last accepted generation in the complete receipt history

scenarios.mutation: Change the persisted schema version to an unsupported value
scenarios.expected: Reject before interpreting or mutating state

scenarios.mutation: Change or omit a profile, boot, log-origin or policy transition-evidence digest in accepted receipt history
scenarios.expected: Reject history whose transition authorization record is missing or malformed

scenarios.mutation: Create an accepted receipt revision gap or duplicate acceptance revision
scenarios.expected: Reject incomplete or duplicated accepted-revision history
